role: authentic argument cases for 16.2.14 mixins whose required parameters are not a theme/config
rules: Each call is transcribed from a 16.2.14 caller, doc example or test at the cited location. mat./local module names become the public m.* forward; a local $config/$theme derived from the caller's theme argument becomes the same derivation from the predeclared standard $__theme. Calls compile at the top level exactly as written (no probe wrapper), on both sides.

private-apply-card-theme-from-tokens.argument_provenance: The $tokens literal is meta.inspect(map.deep-merge(get-m3-tokens(), customizations of card())) from @angular/material-experimental@16.2.14 (the dev-app caller path). It round-trips through meta.inspect unchanged, and compiling this literal call gives byte-identical CSS to matx.theme(matx.token-defaults(matx.get-m3-tokens()), matx.card()) against the 16.2.14 reference.

private-apply-checkbox-theme-from-tokens.argument_provenance: As for private-apply-card-theme-from-tokens with checkbox(); byte-identical to matx.theme(matx.token-defaults(matx.get-m3-tokens()), matx.checkbox()) against the 16.2.14 reference.
